common.aboutBody: Identities are drawn from a seed plus options and never stored. The same seed always presents the same machine, and a coherence check refuses any combination the pages would catch.
common.accountDescription: Licence, sync and team membership. Everything on this machine stays local without an account.
common.assignProxyDescription: Profiles that route through {{url}} {{exitInfo}}. Profiles whose claimed country differs from the proxy exit are marked.
common.assignToProfileDescription: The profile's browser will route through this node. A dedicated proxy process serves it and stops when the browser closes.
common.authError: A username is required to send a password.
common.autoHint: Auto pins this display exactly — its physical size and scale, so a page sees what this machine shows. A pinned resolution draws a scale the target OS offers.
common.coherenceIssues: This profile has coherence issues and will not launch
common.crashDescription: The interface hit an unexpected error and stopped rendering. Reloading usually clears it — your profiles, proxies and subscriptions live on disk and are not affected.
common.createProfileDescription: A seed is drawn for you. The identity it presents is derived on read, so the same profile always looks like the same machine.
common.deleteBulkWarning: {{count}} of them are still used by profiles — those profiles keep their URLs and keep routing, but the entries leave this list.
common.deleteProfileAlertDescription: The profile keeps its browser data in the trash — cookies, sessions, history all come back on restore. Its proxy assignment does not; assign one again after restoring.
common.deleteProfileAlertTitle: The proxy assignment is let go
common.deleteProfileDescription: Moves {{name}} to the store's trash, and it can be restored from there.
common.deleteProxyWarning_one: {{count}} profile routes through this proxy — it keeps the URL and keeps routing, but the entry leaves the list. This cannot be undone.
common.deleteProxyWarning_other: {{count}} profiles route through this proxy — they keep the URL and keep routing, but the entry leaves the list. This cannot be undone.
common.deleteSubscriptionDescription: The subscription and its stored URL are removed. Nodes fetched from it are discarded. This cannot be undone.
common.diagnosticsDescription: A JSON bundle for bug reports: versions, configuration and health. It carries no identities, no proxy URLs and no subscription tokens.
common.diagnosticsHint: Saved wherever you choose; read it before sharing.
common.directRouteHint: No proxy and no subscription node: the profile connects directly. Edit the profile to pick another route.
common.distributeProxiesDescription: Hands the selected proxies to the selected profiles round-robin, one profile per slot. Profiles whose country no selected proxy exits from stay on their current routing.
common.downloadingEngineDescription: The profile list is available as soon as the install finishes.
common.editProfileDescription: The seed stays put — these settings reshape what the profile presents.
common.editProxyDescription: Stored once here, then assigned to any profile that should exit through it.
common.engineDescription: The browser build profiles launch into.
common.everyInvariantHolds: Every invariant holds — the profile will launch as it stands
common.everythingAgreed: Everything the page could read came back as the profile claims it.
common.exportProfileDescription: Writes a portable copy of the profile — its seed, options, hand edits, addons and proxy. Importing it elsewhere re-draws the same machine; browser data stays behind.
common.exportProfilesDescription_one: {{count}} profile — its seed, options, hand edits, addons and proxy. Importing it elsewhere re-draws the same machine; browser data stays behind.
common.exportProfilesDescription_other: {{count}} profiles — their seeds, options, hand edits, addons and proxies. Importing them elsewhere re-draws the same machines; browser data stays behind.
common.exportProxiesDescription_one: {{count}} proxy. TXT is one URL per line; JSON also carries the name and exit country for a round-trip import.
common.exportProxiesDescription_other: {{count}} proxies. TXT is one URL per line; JSON also carries the name and exit country for a round-trip import.
common.extensionsDescription: Paths to .xpi files or unpacked addon directories. A path the engine cannot find is skipped with a launch warning.
common.fingerprintDescription: Fingerprint, overrides, fields, network and coherence.
common.geoGateMismatch: Geo-gate warning: proxy exits in {{observed}}, but profile claims {{expected}}. Proceed with caution!
common.geoGateUnknown: Proxy exit country is not verified (profile claims {{expected}}) — run a proxy check before relying on it
common.geoMismatchWarning_one: {{count}} selected profile claims that this proxy does not exit from — the geo gate may refuse that launch.
common.geoMismatchWarning_other: {{count}} selected profiles claim that this proxy does not exit from — the geo gate may refuse those launches.
common.groupDescription: File profiles that share a purpose together.
common.groupHint: Leave empty for no group; a new name creates it.
common.groupPlaceholder: Pick an existing group, or type a new one
common.importProxiesDescription: One per line: scheme://host:port, host:port, or host:port:user:pass — or a JSON array of {name, url, exit_country} objects. Blank lines and # comments are skipped.
common.importTooltip: Import profiles from an export file
common.includeProxyLogin: Include the proxy login in the file
common.integrationsDescription: Connect external tools to profiles, groups and session data through a local API.
common.listEveryValue: List every compared value, not just the differences
common.movedToTrashHint: Restore it from the trash while its browser data still exists.
common.name: Name
common.neverDrawnAddons: Extension paths come from the profile's own addon list — manage them on the Extensions page, not here.
common.neverDrawnAllowAddonNewTab: Lets extensions observe new-tab pages, widening what an addon can do.
common.neverDrawnAllowMainWorld: Lets an extension reach the page's own execution context, widening what an addon can do.
common.neverDrawnCertificatePaths: Root certificate directories this profile will trust. Caller-supplied files, not identity.
common.neverDrawnCertificates: Root certificate bundles this profile will trust. Caller-supplied files, not identity.
common.neverDrawnDisableTheming: Drops the engine's OS-matching browser chrome, so the window stops looking native.
common.neverDrawnDisableWorldIsolation: Reaches past the page's own execution context — a capability a site can detect, and not one ordinary browsing hands out.
common.neverDrawnForceScopeAccess: Reaches past the page's own execution context — a capability a site can detect, and not one ordinary browsing hands out.
common.neverDrawnHumanizeMinTime: A floor on how long one humanized cursor move may take; the engine default is zero.
common.neverDrawnInstantAnimations: Completes CSS animations at once, which upstream documents as observable.
common.newProxyDescription: A named proxy you keep once and assign to profiles instead of retyping per profile.
common.stopAllTooltip: Close all opened fingerprint browsers and release resources
common.stoppedAllBrowsers: Successfully closed all fingerprint browsers and released resources
common.noAvailableNodes: This subscription has no nodes yet — refresh it and try again.
common.noGroupsHint: Type a name above to create the first one.
common.noHandOverridesHint: Edit a value in the fingerprint to pin it. Overrides are stored as a sparse diff over the drawn identity.
common.noNodesYet: No nodes yet — press Update to fetch them from the provider.
common.noProfilesForAgent: Create a profile first, then start an automation session for it here.
common.noProfilesForExtensions: Create a profile first, then attach extensions to it here.
common.noProfilesHint: Each profile is a seed plus options — the identity is drawn, never stored.
common.noProfilesMatchHint: Try a shorter query, or clear the search field.
common.noProxiesHint: Store each exit once, then assign it to profiles instead of retyping the URL per profile.
common.noSubscriptionsHint: Add a subscription URL and the core turns it into nodes you can test and route through.
common.nodeRuntimeHint: Leave empty to use node from PATH. Python Playwright ships one at …\playwright\driver\node.
common.notesPlaceholder: Anything you want to remember about this identity
common.playwrightDriverPathHint: The playwright-core package directory. Python Playwright bundles one at …\playwright\driver\package.
common.profilesStoreDescription: Where identities are kept: seed, options and hand edits.
common.propertiesEngineUnderstands_one: {{count}} property the engine understands. A saved value becomes an override on the profile; Reset returns the field to what the seed draws.
common.propertiesEngineUnderstands_other: {{count}} properties the engine understands. A saved value becomes an override on the profile; Reset returns the field to what the seed draws.
common.proxyCredentialsWarning: These credentials cross the network readable
common.proxyCredentialsWarningHint: This type sends the username and password without encryption. Treat them as exposed on any network you do not control.
common.proxyDirectHint: No proxy: the profile connects directly.
common.proxyGeoHint: The exit IP must sit in the profile's country ({{country}}), or the launch is refused at the geo gate.
common.proxyLibraryHint: Routes through this stored proxy; its saved exit country is what the geo gate checks against.
common.proxyLoginWarning: The proxy password will be written into the file as plaintext. Anyone who can read the file can use the proxy as you.
common.proxyNoEncryptionWarning: The connection to this proxy is not encrypted
common.proxyNoEncryptionWarningHint: Anyone between this machine and the proxy sees where you go and everything sent outside HTTPS.
common.proxyNoLogin: The proxy is exported without its login — same proxy, no password in the file.
common.proxyNoLoginToInclude: This profile's proxy (or lack of one) carries no login, so there is nothing to include.
common.proxyUnreachable: The proxy did not reach an echo service.
common.proxyUrlHint: The exit IP must sit where a profile claims, or the geo gate refuses the launch.
common.readingProfileHint: A browser is starting with this profile's identity, loading a bundled test page and closing itself. A cold start takes a few seconds; nothing is written to the profile.
common.removeProxyDescription: Selected profiles go back to a direct connection.
common.restoredProfileHint: Its proxy assignment did not follow it into the trash — assign one again.
common.searchExampleDe: Profiles in or summarised as Germany
common.searchHelpDescription: Type freely — name, notes, country, operating system and the machine summary are all matched at once.
common.securityDescription: What protects the stores, stated plainly.
common.sessionRunning: Session running — endpoint copied to the clipboard
common.shortcutsDescription: Every shortcut the application binds, in one list.
common.startAutomationDescription: The profile's browser starts behind a Playwright server; connect from any Playwright client with firefox.connect. The endpoint is copied to the clipboard when the session is up.
common.subscriptionDescription: A subscription URL the proxy core fetches and turns into nodes. The core supports every protocol it knows — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC and more.
common.subscriptionNodesDescription_one: {{count}} node from the provider. Latency is a real request through the node; speed is a download measured through it.
common.subscriptionNodesDescription_other: {{count}} nodes from the provider. Latency is a real request through the node; speed is a download measured through it.
common.subscriptionNodeHint: Every node of this subscription can be picked; a latency test measures them and sorts the list by speed. A local core serves the node and stops when the browser closes.
common.subscriptionRouteHint: The profile launches through this subscription's node; a save keeps a proxy URL or a node route, never both.
common.specialNodesRefreshed: Successfully refreshed {{count}} active official nodes for {{name}}
common.autoCountryGroupHint: Nodes are grouped by country. Click on a country to expand or collapse nodes.
common.noSpecialNodesHint: Servers might have rotated. Click 'Refresh official nodes' above to fetch the latest relays.
common.subscriptionUrlHint: Fetched by the core, not this window. The URL is stored locally and never leaves the machine except to the provider.
common.subscriptionUrlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
common.syncProfilesHint: The URL changes, so the profiles carrying the old one are rewritten with the new.
common.syncProfiles_one: Also update {{count}} profile using this proxy
common.syncProfiles_other: Also update {{count}} profiles using this proxy
common.systemFollows: System follows your operating system setting.
common.trashDescription: Deleted profiles wait here with their browser data. Restore brings one back; purging removes it for good.
common.trashEmpty: Nothing here. Deleted profiles appear in this list.
common.verificationFound: Verification found {{count}} difference(s) — see the Verify tab
common.verifyDescription: The Fingerprint tab shows what the engine is handed. This launches a real browser with that identity, loads a bundled probe page and reads back what a page can actually see — navigator, screen, WebGL limits, extensions, headers — then reports every value that did not come back as claimed.
common.verifyHint: The browser opens a window for a few seconds and closes itself. It uses a throwaway profile directory, so nothing here is added to the profile's own data.
common.verifyProfile: Verify this profile against a running browser
common.warmedUpHint: Cookies and history are in the profile's browser data.
common.warmupDescription: The browser starts headless behind the profile's proxy and dwells on each site below, so cookies, cache and history accumulate in its real browser data. A profile with no history is itself a tell. This takes minutes; the window closes itself when the route is done.
common.warmupNoSites: The warm-up route has no sites

vpngate.transitDirectWarning: (VPNGate nodes often cannot be reached directly; transit relay is recommended)
vpngate.transitActiveHint: ✓ Latency tests and browser traffic will route through this relay node
vpngate.transitDialogDesc: Because VPNGate servers are public and frequently blocked, direct connections may time out. You can select any Proxy, Subscription, Psiphon, or MegaV node as an upstream transit relay.
vpngate.directModeWarning: In direct mode, traffic connects directly to VPNGate servers. In restricted network regions, connections are likely to fail. We recommend setting a transit node such as Psiphon, MegaV, or a custom proxy.
vpngate.noProxiesInLibrary: No proxies found in Proxy Library. Add a proxy first in the Proxies page.
vpngate.noSubscriptions: No custom subscriptions found. Add a subscription first in the Subscriptions page.
vpngate.noSubNodesFound: No nodes found in this subscription.
